background: Citigroup is the holding company of the most international of the large US banks, with services, markets, banking, wealth and US personal banking as its main lines, and a multi-year restructuring behind it.
synthesis: Citigroup is rated A- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 2 Dec 2015. Capital is the weaker side against US banks, CET1 of 11.8% and leverage of 5.2% both below the median, whereas liquidity is a strength, with LCR of 128% in the top quarter. Leverage has fallen 0.4 points since 30 Sep 2025 and LCR has risen 11 points since 31 Mar 2024, with CET1 broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). Recent news is mixed, with a UK fine on one unit for Russia sanctions breaches the main negative.
